en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4601 - Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:
"When the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was taken up to the heavens (Mi'raj), Jibril (as) came to him and said: 'O Muhammad (as)! Verily, Allah (swt), the Blessed and Exalted, says:
I have forgiven those among your followers who engage in Mut'ah with women.'"
